{{page request header|Redirect requests}}
'''Redirects''' redirect to existing pages (usually articles). This is especially useful when searching for pages &mdash; redirects will allow users to bypass the search results list.

Please note that redirects on the Dwarf Fortress Wiki follow a different set of rules from Wikipedia. If you aren't familiar with the rules on this wiki, it may be easier to request a redirect here instead.
